title: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to overthinking things
summary:
The article reviews Qwen 3.8 27B, an Apache 2 licensed, 27B parameter vision-capable LLM released by Alibaba on August 16th, 2026. The author praises its potential, noting its suitable size for laptops and impressive self-reported benchmarks.

A key observation is the model's default "xhigh" reasoning effort, which causes it to "overthink" tasks, leading to extremely long generation times (e.g., 21 minutes for a pelican SVG) and overly complex outputs (e.g., an animated circle for a simple "draw an svg of a circle" prompt). The author strongly recommends using "low" or "no reasoning" levels initially, especially on consumer hardware, though reasoning can be beneficial for more complex tasks like building coding tools.

Despite this default, Qwen 3.8 27B demonstrates excellent capabilities: it precisely identifies bounding boxes in images and effectively drives coding agents like Pi, generating Python code and scripts.

The main drawback is its speed, returning only 15-30 tokens per second, making it feel slow compared to hosted API models. However, Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture, when utilized with `llama serve`, significantly boosts inference performance by about 72%.

Ultimately, the author is amazed by the model's ability to run a general-purpose, vision-capable LLM with strong tool-calling and code generation—all within a 17GB file on a capable laptop. This progress highlights that powerful, open-weight models no longer require expensive datacenter hardware.
chinese_title: Qwen 3.8 27B 很优秀，但它默认会想太多。
chinese_summary:
本文评测了阿里巴巴于2026年8月16日发布的Qwen 3.8 27B，这是一个采用Apache 2许可、拥有27B参数且具备视觉能力的LLM。作者赞扬了它的潜力，指出其适合在笔记本电脑上运行的尺寸以及令人印象深刻的自测基准。

一个关键发现是，该模型默认的“xhigh”推理级别导致它对任务“过度思考”，从而产生了极长的生成时间（例如，生成一个鹈鹕SVG需21分钟）和过于复杂的输出（例如，对于简单的“绘制一个圆形SVG”提示，却生成了一个动画圆形）。作者强烈建议最初使用“low”或“no reasoning”级别，尤其是在消费级硬件上，尽管推理对于构建编码工具等更复杂的任务可能是有益的。

尽管有此默认设置，Qwen 3.8 27B 仍展示了出色的能力：它能精确识别图像中的边界框，并有效驱动像Pi这样的编码代理，生成Python代码和脚本。

主要缺点是其速度，每秒仅返回15-30个token，与托管API模型相比感觉很慢。然而，多token预测（MTP）架构与`llama serve`结合使用时，可将推理性能显著提升约72%。

最终，作者对该模型能够在性能强大的笔记本电脑上的一个17GB文件中运行一个通用的、具备视觉能力的LLM，并具有强大的工具调用和代码生成能力感到惊叹。这一进展强调了强大的、开放权重的模型不再需要昂贵的数据中心硬件。

title: Incident with Github.com
summary:
On December 6, 2023, GitHub experienced a significant outage affecting multiple services, including Actions, Packages, Pages, Codespaces, and API requests. The incident began at 13:50 UTC and was triggered by an internal networking update intended to improve resilience. This update inadvertently caused a network partitioning event, isolating critical portions of GitHub's infrastructure and leading to degraded performance and errors across various products.

Engineers identified the networking issue as the root cause and initiated a rollback of the problematic changes. The network was fully restored by 14:48 UTC, and GitHub began to see recovery across most services by 15:35 UTC. However, lingering issues, particularly with GitHub Actions and webhook delivery, persisted for some time, requiring further remediation.

The incident was declared resolved at 17:34 UTC, but GitHub continued to monitor the system for full stability. The company committed to a thorough internal review to prevent recurrence and enhance their change management and network architecture.
chinese_title: GitHub.com 事件
chinese_summary:
2023年12月6日，GitHub经历了一次严重的服务中断，影响了包括Actions、Packages、Pages、Codespaces以及API请求在内的多项服务。此次事件始于协调世界时（UTC）13:50，起因是一次旨在提高系统韧性的内部网络更新。这次更新意外地引发了网络分区事件，隔离了GitHub基础设施的关键部分，导致多种产品性能下降并出现错误。

工程师将网络问题确定为根本原因，并启动了对问题更改的回滚。网络于协调世界时14:48完全恢复，GitHub的大多数服务在协调世界时15:35开始恢复。然而，遗留问题，特别是GitHub Actions和webhook交付方面的问题，持续了一段时间，需要进一步修复。

该事件于协调世界时17:34宣布解决，但GitHub继续监控系统以确保完全稳定。该公司承诺进行彻底的内部审查，以防止再次发生，并改进其变更管理和网络架构。

title: Firefox for iOS now has a native adblocker
summary: The provided content, despite its title "Firefox for iOS now has a native adblocker," is not an article detailing this new feature. Instead, it is an error message indicating that a website component failed to load. The message attributes this failure to various potential issues, including disabled JavaScript, network problems, browser settings, or, significantly, an active ad blocker. It instructs the user to enable JavaScript, verify their connection, disable ad blockers, or use another browser to resolve the problem. The irony is notable, as an error message suggesting disabling an ad blocker appears in the context of a title announcing a new native ad blocker.

title: Stripe will reportedly acquire OpenRouter for $7B+
summary:
Stripe is reportedly set to acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion, according to a Bloomberg report published on August 16, 2026. This news follows earlier reports from The Wall Street Journal indicating acquisition talks were underway.

OpenRouter specializes in providing customers with a single access point to select and utilize various AI models based on their specific needs and budget, effectively preventing vendor lock-in. CEO Alex Atallah previously likened the company to "Stripe for AI" due to its role in simplifying access to different systems. The startup boasts 8 million global users and offers access to over 400 models.

In May, OpenRouter raised a $113 million Series B round, valuing the company at $1.3 billion, with investors including Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Menlo Ventures, and Alphabet’s CapitalG. A Stripe spokesperson declined to comment on the acquisition rumors.
chinese_title: 据报道，Stripe 将以逾70亿美元收购 OpenRouter。
chinese_summary:
据彭博社2026年8月16日发布的一份报告，Stripe据称将以逾70亿美元的价格收购AI网关初创公司OpenRouter。此消息此前已在《华尔街日报》的报道中有所提及，当时指出收购谈判正在进行中。

OpenRouter专注于为客户提供单一访问点，使其能够根据特定需求和预算选择并利用各种AI模型，有效避免了供应商锁定。首席执行官亚历克斯·阿塔拉此前曾将该公司比作“AI界的Stripe”，因为它在简化不同系统访问方面发挥着作用。这家初创公司拥有800万全球用户，并提供对400多种模型的访问。

五月，OpenRouter完成了1.13亿美元的B轮融资，公司估值达到13亿美元，投资者包括红杉资本、安德森·霍洛维茨基金、门罗风投以及Alphabet旗下的CapitalG。Stripe的一位发言人拒绝就收购传闻发表评论。

title: Super El Niño Keeps Growing as New Forecasts Reach Record Territory Ahead Winter
summary:
A "Super El Niño" event is rapidly strengthening across the tropical Pacific for 2026/2027, with new data and forecasts indicating it will reach record-breaking intensity. This accelerated growth is fueled by unprecedented westerly wind anomalies across the equatorial Pacific and a powerful subsurface Kelvin Wave, continuously supplying warm water. The event has already surpassed the speed and strength of the 2015-2016 Super El Niño and is projected to peak around November-December with anomalies potentially exceeding +3°C in the main ENSO region, marking it as a historic event.

This Super El Niño is profoundly reshaping global atmospheric circulation, establishing an "atmospheric standing wave." Evidence includes a record-high Multivariate ENSO Index (MEI) for June-July 2026, confirming strong oceanic and atmospheric coupling. The circulation shift intensifies the jet stream, creating a deeper Pacific trough and a stronger Canadian ridge.

Consequently, the Fall 2026 forecast already displays a pattern typically associated with an El Niño Winter: a high-pressure anomaly over Canada, a low-pressure area in the North Pacific, and an active storm track across the southern United States into the Atlantic. This translates to milder temperatures in the northern US and Canada, with normal temperatures for the south-central and eastern US due to increased storm activity. Continued westerly winds are expected to further intensify the Super El Niño as Winter approaches.
chinese_title: 超强厄尔尼诺持续增强，冬季来临前最新预测已创历史新高
chinese_summary:
2026/2027年，一场“超级厄尔尼诺”事件正在热带太平洋迅速增强，新数据和预测表明，其强度将达到破纪录水平。这种加速增长得益于赤道太平洋前所未有的西风异常以及强大的次表层开尔文波，后者不断输送暖水。该事件已超越2015-2016年超级厄尔尼诺的速度和强度，预计将在11-12月达到峰值，主要ENSO区域的异常可能超过+3°C，标志着这是一次历史性事件。

这次超级厄尔尼诺事件正在深刻重塑全球大气环流，形成一个“大气驻波”。证据包括2026年6-7月创纪录高的多变量ENSO指数（MEI），证实了强大的海洋与大气耦合。环流变化加剧了急流，形成了更深的太平洋低压槽和更强的加拿大高压脊。

因此，2026年秋季的预报已经显示出通常与厄尔尼诺冬季相关的模式：加拿大上空出现高压异常，北太平洋出现低压区，以及一条活跃的风暴路径横穿美国南部进入大西洋。这意味着美国北部和加拿大气温将更温和，而美国中南部和东部由于风暴活动增加，气温将正常。随着冬季临近，持续的西风预计将进一步增强超级厄尔尼诺事件。
